scripts.dev: concurrently "npm -w apps/api run dev" "npm -w apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w apps/api run typecheck && npm -w apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm -w apps/api run test && npm -w apps/web run test
scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run format:check
